messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: P0 — Smart routing error spike in us-west-2. Error rate 12% (baseline <1%), per-route latency increased. Paging oncall: @oncall-ana.

oncall-ana: on it. Can someone paste the alert link?

incident-bot: https://alerts.redwood.example/alerts/98321 — recent change: routing-config v2.3.0 deployed ~20m ago (automated rollout).

sre-mike: I’m tailing the routing-service logs, seeing lots of policy decisions that pick `model_variant: small-v1` instead of expected `large-v2`. Latency for small-v1 fails the protocol in some cases (OOMs on quant backend).

platform-lucy: that sounds like the deprecated field `default_variant` was removed in schema v2 and fallback behavior changed to pick the cheapest compatible variant. Shockingly the migration left some customers still setting `default_variant`.

eng-tom: confirming — config validation currently treats deprecated `default_variant` as present but ignores it, then routing policy engine hits a fallback path which prefers `cost_optimized` variant if `region_preference` missing. So chains: missing region -> cost pick -> incompatible model -> error.

oncall-ana: ok immediate mitigation: can we force an emergency routing override to route traffic for affected tenants to their pinned model variant in us-west-2 primary pool?

platform-lucy: yes. I can apply a cluster-level override. Pushing temporary policy now: `routing.override = { "match": "@affected_customers", "force_variant": "large-v2", "risk": "high" }`

eng-tom: +1 to override. Also rolling back the schema change would require coordinate with config service owners — may take longer.

support-jess: which customers are hitting this? I’m seeing support tickets from tenant: acme-markets and several chatters from fin-ai-prod. Need impact notes.

platform-lucy: affected_tenants list (from logs): acme-markets, fin-ai-prod, luma-ads, two internal test orgs. Estimated requests impacted ~4.3k rps for 12m window.

customer-ops-bot: Customer impact summary generated:
- acme-markets: 15% of requests returned 5xx, increased latency to 3.4s median.
- fin-ai-prod: intermittent request rejections, several downstream job failures.
- luma-ads: failover to eu-central briefly observed.
(see https://customers.redwood.example/impact/98321)

eng-tom: I’m going to patch routing-engine to treat deprecated `default_variant` as authoritative if present and to validate compatibility before fallback. Quick PR in flight: `hotfix/routing-deprec-fix`.

sre-mike: oncall — can you confirm health checks after override applied?

oncall-ana: override pushed at 1845007100. Monitoring now.

incident-bot: deploy-bot: emergency policy override applied (id=ovr-20260315-1) by platform-lucy at 1845007100.

sre-mike: metrics showing error rate dropping from 12% -> 2.1% in 90s. Latency normalizing.

support-jess: I’ll message affected customers with a short Note: We have applied an emergency override and are continuing to investigate root cause; we expect normalization within 30 minutes.

eng-tom: PR opened: https://git.redwood.example/routing/merge_requests/485 — hotfix changes:

```
- if (config.hasDeprecated('default_variant')) {
-  useDeprecatedDefault();
- }
+ if (config.hasDeprecated('default_variant')) {
+  // treat as explicit pin, validate compatibility with region/model
+  if (!isCompatible(config.default_variant, target_region)) {
+    log.warn('deprecated default_variant incompatible', config);
+    // fallback to pinned_primary or fail open to avoid cheap variant
+    usePinnedPrimary();
+  } else {
+    useDeprecatedDefault();
+  }
+}
```

platform-lucy: CI for hotfix passed in canary. I’ll coordinate a fast rollout to prod.

oncall-ana: handing pager to @sre-mike in 30m — please maintain incident until final rollback or migration script done.

sre-mike: taking over. will keep watch on customer impact dashboard.

incident-bot: incident status: Mitigated (override applied). Root cause suspected: schema change removed behavioral contract for deprecated `default_variant` leading to unintended fallback to cost_optimized variant.

eng-tom: next steps:
- ship hotfix that treats deprecated field as authoritative + compatibility check (PR 485).
- add explicit validation to config service to reject configs referencing removed fields (migration helper).
- create a migration job to rewrite deprecated fields to `pinned_variant` for existing configs.
- post-mortem and a customer postmortem note.

support-jess: drafting customer message. Will include timeline, impact, mitigation steps and note about rollback plan.

platform-lucy: rolling hotfix at 1845007700 -> canary -> full rollout if stable.

incident-bot: deploy-bot: hotfix rollout started (hotfix/routing-deprec-fix) at 1845007700. Canary OK at 10m.

sre-mike: metrics fully back to baseline by 1845007900. Error rate <0.5%. No additional region failovers observed.

eng-tom: migration job scheduled: `rewrite-deprecated-defaults --dry-run` first, then apply at 2026-03-16 01:00 UTC. I’ll add a validation step in config-api to reject deprecated keys after migration.

support-jess: customer messages sent to affected tenants at 1845008000. Responses: acme-markets confirmed incident and appreciated the quick mitigation.

oncall-ana: handing back to normal rotation, incident status to Monitoring.

incident-bot: incident update: Resolved -> Monitoring. Root cause: config schema change + silent fallback semantics. Action items assigned.

eng-tom: I’ll own the postmortem doc and ensure we include config-service patch, migration plan, and tests.

platform-lucy: note for runbook: add a check in `deploy-config-schema` pipeline that prevents schema changes which alter runtime fallback semantics without explicit migration path.

sre-mike: closing notes: pager handled, override removed at 1845008600 after hotfix validated; new validation will prevent similar surprises.

customer-ops-bot: Postmortem link: https://incidents.redwood.example/98321/postmortem (draft).

support-jess: thanks everyone. :heart:

eng-tom: filing follow-up tasks in sprint board now.

platform-lucy: thumbs to everyone for fast response :tada:
